page.overview:
Who is Vera Briggs?

Vera Briggs was the wife of Jackson "Jax" Briggs and mother of their daughter, Jacqui; they met while Jax was in recovery after his time as a revenant. Vera is close friends with Jax's former Special Forces partner, Sonya Blade, and is aware of her husband's involvement in the protection of Earthrealm.

Vera called her daughter Jacqui, expressing her concern over having not heard from her daughter in several days when her husband Jax was thrown through a nearby window. Vera quickly ran to his side, and when Jax told her to run, Vera refused, even as the Outworlder Reiko made his way through the wall of their home. Reiko quickly incapacitated Jax, demanding the Kamidogu dagger that Raiden had entrusted him.

Jax refused, so Reiko snatched Vera by her throat and held her aloft in the air, giving Jax the ultimatum of his family for the dagger. Jax complied and Reiko left with the dagger.

Vera greeted the thunder god Raiden when he arrived at the Briggs' farm, explaining to him Reiko's attack, before demanding that Raiden get Jacqui back, seeing him responsible for Reiko's attack as he had given Jax the dagger.
